gloss: normal year, average year, every year

definitions.gloss: normal year, average year, every year
definitions.explanation: Refers to what is typical or usual compared to other years. Used as a baseline for comparison, expressing what happens in an ordinary year.

examples.japanese: {例年|れいねん}より{暑|あつ}い{夏|なつ}だ。
examples.english: It's a hotter summer than usual.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{開花|かいか}は{例年|れいねん}{通|どお}りだった。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms bloomed on their usual schedule.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{来場者数|らいじょうしゃすう}は{例年|れいねん}を{大|おお}きく{上回|うわまわ}った。
examples.english: This year's attendance greatly exceeded the average of previous years.

notes:
Most commonly used in comparative expressions with より (compared to) or {通|どお}り (same as). Frequently appears in weather reports, seasonal event coverage, and business performance discussions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {例年|れいねん}より (compared to the average year)
- {例年|れいねん}{通|どお}り (same as usual, as every year)
- {例年|れいねん}に{比|くら}べて (compared to the usual)
- {例年|れいねん}を{上回|うわまわ}る (exceed the average)
